locators.normalized_extract: AQY232G3HSX: SOP4 reel-X, 1000/reel; 60 V, 2 A; operating -40..125 C; not an overcurrent protector.
At IF=5 mA: Vf<=1.7 V, Ron<=0.12 ohm (IL maximum, <=1 s). At IF=0, VL=60 V: leakage<=1 uA. Turnoff<=0.5 ms at IF=5 mA, IL=100 mA, VL=10 V. Isolation capacitance<=1.5 pF, not contact capacitance.
At 25 C: LED 2..20 mA; contact 48 V maximum, 2 A maximum.
